fields.subject: Shard Set Fan-Out
fields.condition: a query contract targets either every shard in a shard set or the shard entries supplied by ShardsValues
fields.trigger: ShardSetsBase<TConfiguration>.ShardSetReadFirst: a caller invokes QueryAsync, MapReaderAsync, or MapOutputAsync with its parameters
fields.response: start a read for every target shard, passing each one a cancellation token linked to the caller-supplied token, and complete with the first non-null TModel produced by any target shard
fields.postcondition: once a non-null result is chosen, the remaining (losing) target reads are cancelled through that linked token, and their outcomes, including any late failure, are observed and never surfaced to the caller; a shard read that failed or was cancelled is ignored whenever another shard produces a result. When no target read produces a non-null result: if the caller's token was cancelled the call throws OperationCanceledException; otherwise, if any shard read failed, that failure is rethrown (a single failure as-is, several together as an AggregateException); otherwise the call returns default(TModel). An empty target selection yields default(TModel) without reaching any shard.
